info.title: DoubleData Proxy API
info.description: Manage proxy usage, wallet balance, orders, subscriptions, rotations, and IP authorization. Your API key selects the workspace; do not send an organization ID.

tags.name: Stats & usage
tags.description: Date-range bandwidth, request counts, and actual wallet usage charges for your proxy credentials.

tags.name: Balance
tags.description: The organization USD balance shared with the DoubleData website.

tags.name: Catalog
tags.description: Static ISP tiers and cached country availability.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Server-priced wallet orders and asynchronous provisioning.

tags.name: Subscriptions
tags.description: Active Static ISP subscriptions and their connection records.

tags.name: IP authorization
tags.description: The source IP authorized for a subscription.

tags.name: Credentials
tags.description: Residential, datacenter, and mobile proxy credentials and their traffic limits.

tags.name: Invoices
tags.description: Organization invoices and invoice PDF downloads.

get.description: Read bandwidth, requests, and wallet charges for Residential, Datacenter, Mobile, and ISP credentials. Static ISP and Static Datacenter subscriptions are excluded. Recent usage and charges may take a short time to appear.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive UTC start date. Provide both dates, or omit both for the current UTC calendar month.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive UTC end date, after `from`, within 366 days. Use next month's first day for a full month.

parameters.name: credential_id
parameters.description: Select one credential ID from this response. Cannot combine with `username`. Missing or inaccessible credentials return `404`.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Base proxy username, without targeting or session suffixes. Cannot combine with `credential_id`.

200.description: Selected credential usage. An empty workspace returns an empty credentials array and zero totals.

get.description: Check your USD balance, shared with the dashboard. Add funds on the website; the API has no funding endpoint.
List residential, datacenter, and mobile credentials in your organization. Passwords are not included; get one credential to read its password.

post.description: Create a credential for residential, datacenter, or mobile traffic. Your organization needs a GB package for that product or a positive balance.

get.description: Return one credential with its password and gateway details.

delete.description: Permanently delete a credential. Connections that use it stop working.

get.description: Return a credential's total, daily, weekly, and monthly limits in MB with current consumption and reset times. Periods reset in UTC.

put.description: Change one or more limits. Omitted limits keep their value; `0` removes a limit.

get.description: List your organization's invoices, newest first. Draft invoices are not included.

parameters.name: starting_after
parameters.description: Return invoices after this invoice ID. Use `next_cursor` from the previous page.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only return invoices with this status.

get.description: Download the invoice as a PDF file. Returns `409` with `not_available` when the PDF is not ready yet.

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment filename, based on the invoice number.

get.description: Browse shared, private, and dedicated packages with cached country availability. Create a quote to confirm availability and price.

post.description: Get a temporary quote with live availability and pricing. Your wallet is not charged.
Charge your wallet for a valid quote, then start asynchronous proxy setup. Confirming the same quote again never charges twice.

get.description: Check proxy setup progress. Keep polling while `status` is `processing` or `outcome_unknown`.
List your active Static ISP subscriptions, including rotation allowances and IP authorization.

delete.description: Stop automatic renewal. Your subscription and proxies stay available until `current_period_end`. Repeating the request is safe.

get.description: List the subscription's assigned proxies, connection credentials, and rotation eligibility. Keep credentials secret.

post.description: Replace 1–100 unique active proxy IPs asynchronously, keeping each IP's country. This changes live proxies. Poll the returned status URL before using new connection details.

get.description: Check a rotation's status and ordered results. Existing rotations return `200`, including `partially_succeeded` and `failed` outcomes.

error.message: This proxy could not be rotated at this time. Please try again.

get.description: Read the subscription's authorized source IP, or `null` if none is set.

put.description: Set or replace the subscription's authorized source IP. Changes live access. Sending the current IP succeeds without changes.

delete.description: Remove the subscription's source IP authorization. Changes live access. Succeeds even when no IP is authorized.

Username.name: username
Username.description: Base proxy username, without targeting or session suffixes.

InvoiceID.name: invoiceId
InvoiceID.description: The invoice ID from the invoice list.

RequestID.description: A request UUID to include when contacting support.

CacheControl.description: Responses are not stored in shared or browser caches.

Location.description: The relative status URL of the accepted asynchronous operation.

PollAfter.description: Wait at least this many seconds before the first status poll.

RateLimitRetryAfter.description: When present, wait at least this many seconds before retrying.

username.description: Base proxy username. Append targeting parameters when you connect.

funding_source.description: What pays for traffic: a GB package or the organization balance.

limits_mb.description: Traffic limits in MB. `0` means no limit.

region.description: eu and us on the public service; default for a single-gateway deployment.

https.description: Null when the deployment does not serve HTTPS proxy connections.

password.description: Proxy password. Treat it as a secret.

name.description: Display name shown in the dashboard.

traffic_limit_mb.description: MB. Use `0` to remove the limit.

daily_limit_mb.description: MB. Use `0` to remove the limit.

weekly_limit_mb.description: MB. Use `0` to remove the limit.

monthly_limit_mb.description: MB. Use `0` to remove the limit.

hosted_invoice_url.description: Page where the invoice can be viewed and paid.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `starting_after` to get the next page.

UsageTotals.description: Wallet charges exclude package purchases, package-funded traffic, subscription fees, top-ups, manual adjustments, and positive ledger entries.

bandwidth_bytes.description: Recorded traffic in bytes. Divide by 1,000,000,000 for decimal GB.

wallet_spent_cents.description: Actual usage debits (USD cents), dated by usage window start. Older debits without usage windows use their posting date.

id.description: Stable proxy credential ID, separate from static subscription IDs.

username.description: Base proxy username. No password is returned.

display_name.description: Your credential name, or an empty string if unset.

enabled.description: Current credential state; disabled credentials retain their usage history.

credentials.description: All current credentials unless filtered, including disabled and unused ones. Excludes deleted credentials. Ordered by username, then ID.

balance_cents.description: Available organization balance in USD cents.

features.description: Optional features; omit or send `[]` for none. Use listed nonempty values. Quotes validate availability and combinations.

status_url.description: Relative URL to poll for status. Present in the order-acceptance response.

rotations_total.description: Rotation units available for the current subscription period before use.

rotations_remaining.description: Individual IP replacements still available in the current period.

rotations_reset_at.description: When the current rotation allowance period ends.

rotation_in_progress.description: Whether a rotation is currently active for this subscription.

ip_authorization.description: The currently authorized source IP, or null.

ips.description: Unique public IPv4 addresses currently active in the subscription. Results preserve this order.

status_url.description: Relative URL to poll for status.

message.const: This proxy could not be rotated at this time. Please try again.

results.description: Results follow the submitted IP order. May be absent until results are available.

ip.description: The public IPv4 address to authorize.

BadRequest.description: Invalid ID, request body, or selected IPs.

error.message: One or more IPs are not active in this subscription.

Unauthorized.description: The API key is missing, invalid, or revoked.

error.message: A valid API key is required.

PaymentRequired.description: The organization balance cannot cover the order.

error.message: The organization balance cannot cover this order. Add funds on the website and try again.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found.

Conflict.description: Quote expired, conflicting request, or another subscription change is running.

TooManyRequests.description: Request limit or rotation allowance reached.

InternalError.description: The request could not be completed.
